title: tigridia citrina
intro: Tigridia citrina, commonly known as the yellow or Mexican tiger flower, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Iridaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and possessing antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tigridia citrina include its potential to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antifungal properties, which can aid in soothing various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
